text:
clare (PM): Final GA acceptance checklist up. Need owners for SLA blurb, SLOs, monitoring alerts, runbook fallback snippet, pricing footnote. Quick ack + blockers?

dave (SRE): I'll own SLOs + alerts + fallback. Two asks: confirm hosted vs dedicated floors, and permission to run a staged traffic-steer during burn-in.

mei (Product): Product ok with slightly higher p99 for long-context models if documented. Need Sales one-liner for Dedicated SLA.

ana (Sales): One-liner request: 'Dedicated deployments include contractual SLAs; pricing & credits handled via account.' Legal needs final wording.

leo (Docs): I will draft public GA readiness doc + internal runbook. Need promql and CLI examples for fallback. ETA Friday if SRE provides artifacts.

dave (SRE): Draft SLOs:
```yaml
hosted:
  availability: "99.95%"
  latency_p99: "<=350ms"
dedicated:
  availability: "99.9%"
  latency_p99: "<=500ms"
```
Alert placeholder (promql):
```promql
(sum(rate(model_response_error_total[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(model_requests_total[5m])) by (model)) > 0.05
```
CLI fallback example:
```bash
redwood traffic shift --policy fallback --from model-xl --to model-safe --reason error_budget_burn
```
Will refine flags.

legal-bot: Reminder: public SLA language requires legal review. Include credit cap & exclusions.

clare (PM): Action items:
- dave: finalize SLO doc + promql + CLI -> Thu EOD
- leo: publish GA doc + runbook draft -> Fri EOD
- ana: draft customer SLA sentence + credit calc -> Mon
- mei: decision on premium SLA gating (post-GA vs pilot) -> Mon
- oncall-bot: confirm GA-week rota -> Thu

mei (Product): Product will sign off for GA if docs published, oncall rota staffed, SLOs documented, and provisional pricing page with Dedicated footnote. Premium SLA is non-blocking.

ana (Sales): Ack. That one-liner is enough for prospects.

leo (Docs): Will post runbook to #eng-oncall for review once dave drops artifacts.

oncall-bot: GA-week rota confirmed.

clare (PM): If no objections by Thu EOD we'll mark "Ready for greenlight" and schedule readout. Please add blockers to the acceptance sheet: https://intra.redwood/ga-acceptance.

dave (SRE): ack.

mei (Product): ack.

ana (Sales): ack.

leo (Docs): ack.
